contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IM[P G]ORDIANVS PIVS FEL AVG ; R/ PM TRPPIIII COS IIII[-]

Base silver coin. Possibly a base metal quinarius of Gordian III (238-244), third or fourth issue of 240-244, mint of Rome, possibly RIC vol. 4 part 3 nos 76-77. Obverse description: Bust laureate draped right; clean-shaven with pointed nose. Obverse inscription: IM[P G]ORDIANVS PIVS FEL AVG. Reverse description: Figure draped standing left holding patera over flame on altar. Reverse inscription:…
